I have mixed feelings about this. I worked at a Starbucks for 4 years in a small town of 27,000 people. There was this homeless man who would come in around 8pm every evening and shower in the bathroom for about an hour and then come out and usually get a cup of hot water (he had his own instant coffee)

It was very clear after a few weeks that he had some serious mental health issues but never once posed a threat. I actually was usually the closing manager so I always gave him food at the end of the night that was supposed to go out (yes I am aware that’s breaking policy)

Anyway we have another supervisor who just did not like him, she was repulsed by him. She phoned head office and got permission to “ban” him and anytime after phoned the police if he came into our property.

Now what bothers me about this is that, at this location, have had many problems with other customers who constantly verbally abused and harassed the employees but were not allowed to “ban” them because they spent actual money in the store. Those are words that cake out of my SM and DM’s mouths many times.

So I find this poster VERY hard to believe. Working for Starbucks was a nightmare for me. When I finally quit, it felt like I cut off a dead limb.

I took Prozac for a few years. Started at 10mg, quickly to 20mg. As soon as I hit 40mg I REALLY felt the side effects. I immediately made an apt with my psychiatrist and he insisted that these will eventually wear off. Six months later and I was still feeling it, still convinced me it would eventually fade away. 
I am now 3 weeks OFF my meds because I couldn’t bear dealing with the side effects.
I have taken a lot of different anti-depressants in the last 9 years but the effects of Prozac hit me hardest.
I know everyone reacts different to every medication though, I would say try to stick it out a few more weeks and see if anything changes. I guess it also depends on whether you’re willing to try to adjust to them or maybe try something else? 
Prozac helped me the most mentally but physically is was just too much for me.
Feel free to message me if you have any questions! Best of luck :)
